programme.title: Andromeda: Stjernekrydsede
programme.desc: Rommies avatar bliver forelsket i det, der viser sig at være avataren af et krigsskib ved navn Gabriel. Gabriel forsøger at inficere Rommie med en virus, der sender sine planer til krigsskibet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det er et dejligt lys
programme.desc: Beka tager Andromeda med til Tarn-Vedra, men længere tid i slipstrømmen giver bivirkninger. For at bekæmpe dem begynder Beka at tage Flash og bliver snart afhængig.

programme.title: Andromeda: Endelig er tiden kommet
programme.desc: En gammel erindring fra Andromeda aktiveres ved et uheld, hvilket sender hende på en mission og efterlader Dylan og besætningen ude af stand til at tilsidesætte kommandoen

programme.title: Andromeda: Det voksende kredsløb
programme.desc: Dylan og Rommie skal redde Tyr, Harper og Rev fra et Magog-verdenskib.

programme.title: Andromeda: Exitstrategier
programme.desc: Dylan, Beka, Rev og Tyr styrter ned efter at være undsluppet en bande nietzscheanere, men står snart over for en ny trussel: Rev's behov for at spise.

programme.title: Andromeda: Et hjerte for falskhed indrammet
programme.desc: Besætningen skal stjæle en juvel, som er centrum for en fejde mellem en driftsejer og Than. Beka falder for en sikkerhedschef, som tidligere var tyv.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ubarmhjertig som solen
programme.desc: Andromeda besvarer et nødopkald, da et fragtskib bliver angrebet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Sidste udkald ved den ødelagte hammer
programme.desc: Besætningen leder efter en længe forsvundet leder af Commonwealth, som er gået i skjul.
programme.sub-title: Sidste udkald ved den ødelagte hammer

programme.title: Andromeda: Alt for menneskeligt
programme.desc: Dylan, Beka og Trance tager med Rommie for at finde ud af noget om et våben, der udvikles på en planet, som ikke har tillid til AI.

programme.title: Andromeda: Una Salus Victus
programme.desc: Andromeda har til opgave at eskortere medicinske skibe sikkert gennem Drago-Kazov-rummet

programme.title: Andromeda: Hjemmefester
programme.desc: En planet med overlevende fra Commonwealth, som ledes af Dylans tidligere forlovede, bliver inviteret til at slutte sig til det nye Commonwealth.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ind i labyrinten
programme.desc: En agent fra Abyss forsøger at lokke Harper til at slutte sig til Magog.

programme.title: Andromeda: Prinsen
programme.desc: Da de redder en ung prins fra et oprør, der dræber resten af hans familie, bliver Dylan og Tyr bedt om at blive hans rådgivere.

programme.title: Andromeda: Bunker Hill
programme.desc: Dylan og hans nye flåde fra Commonwealth tager kampen op mod Drago-Kazov-flåden, men finder den meget større end forventet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ouroboros
programme.desc: Magog-æggene i Harper er begyndt at klække, så holdet bygger en Tesseract-maskine.

programme.title: Andromeda: Lava og raketter
programme.desc: Dylan overtager en turistbåd i et forsøg på at undslippe lejesoldaterne.

programme.title: Andromeda: Alle mine synder skal huskes
programme.desc: En identifikation af et lig går galt, da det viser sig, at Bekas tidligere besætningsmedlem ikke er død.

programme.title: Andromeda: Enfluernes dans
programme.desc: Andromeda redder døende mennesker fra en drivkraft, men de bliver snart til zombier, der styres af et hive-mind.

programme.title: Andromeda: I himlen er der nu tre
programme.desc: Skaberens motor er i stand til at omskrive universet efter ejerens ønsker. Dylan, Beka og Trance må få fat i den, før nogen med mørke planer får fat i den.
programme.sub-title: I himlen er der nu tre

programme.title: Andromeda: Det, vi ikke kan ændre
programme.desc: Et sort hul slår Dylan ud og sender ham ind i en alternativ virkelighed med kone og barn.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den skønne ukendte
programme.desc: Besætningen redder en af de længe forsvundne grundlæggere af Commonwealth, men opdager, at hun måske er mere besværlig, end hun er værd.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Headquarters
programme.desc: When hunters reported finding a skull in a Texas canyon, police immediately began an investigation. With a forensic artist's reconstruction, police eventually learned the victim's identity. Now all they had to do was find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: One for the Road
programme.desc: A married couple decided to escape the cold of winter with a mini-vacation in Key West. The wife went missing and police searched every square inch of the island; they found nothing but a pair of sandals which might have belonged to her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Army of Evidence
programme.desc: A mother of two young children was found dead in her bedroom. Her death was ruled a suicide — but when investigators learned she had almost died in a house fire three years earlier, they decided to take another look at the evidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shear Luck
programme.desc: In 1991, when the wife of a serviceman was brutally murdered in the Philippines, investigators had to reassemble a tiny computer disk that had been cut to pieces in order to find the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tagging a Suspect
programme.desc: Bombings are difficult to solve because the perpetrator isn't usually at the scene and the evidence goes up in smoke. In this case, pieces of plastic the size of grains of sand hold the key to finding a murderer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Strong Impressions
programme.desc: The wife of an Air Force officer was found dead in her bed with a plastic laundry bag near her face. Further investigation proved that the scene had been staged. Her death wasn't an accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cereal Killer
programme.desc: When a fire destroyed most of a home and a young boy went missing, police organized the largest search in the history of their small town. First the boy's backpack was discovered five miles from home, then his body was found 50 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Crash Course
programme.desc: A highway patrolman was dispatched to what he thought would be a routine traffic accident — until he looked in the car. He had seen hundreds of accidents, but none with as much blood as this.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Leg Up On Crime
programme.desc: The decomposed body of a young woman was discovered in a Bakersfield irrigation canal. If there was trace evidence, it had been washed away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tight-Fitting Genes
programme.desc: A behavioral profile caused the Baton Rouge Police Department to search for the wrong man. The real perpetrator may have eluded arrest, had it not been for a molecular biologist who painted DNA picture of the suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Valentine
programme.desc: An obstetrician returned home from the hospital and found his wife on the bathroom floor. She was covered with blood and not breathing. He tried unsuccessfully to revive her, staining his clothes with her blood in the process.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Picture This
programme.desc: A Modesto, California teenager goes missing. With no signs of struggle in her home, police suspect she has simply run away — until her naked, bruised body is discovered in a ditch 20 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Oily in the Morning
programme.desc: When police recovered the submerged car of a missing man, they expected to find his body — but it wasn't there. The investigation that followed would uncover an obsession turned deadly.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Gold Rush
programme.desc: Emergency dispatch received a call from a man who said his girlfriend shot and killed herself. The autopsy revealed that the gunshot wound was not self-inflicted, and the evidence on her body would give police a golden opportunity to catch her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Four on the Floor
programme.desc: When a Native American woman is brutally killed in the desert of New Mexico, her killers leave a crime scene rich in forensic evidence: tire tracks, shoe impressions and even the murder weapons.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Writer's Block
programme.desc: A brilliant young architect falls ill and dies just before she is to testify in a criminal trial. The autopsy reveals she'd been poisoned with arsenic. Investigators must determine who had a motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Clean Getaway
programme.desc: When a dry cleaner employee is raped and murdered in her store, police turn to forensic science for the answers they need.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Prints Among Thieves
programme.desc: The murder of an eccentric millionaire was not entirely unexpected; he flaunted his wealth and cared little for personal security. The evidence at the crime seemed to indicate robbery, but investigators wondered if there was something more.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unholy Alliance
programme.desc: When a young woman disappeared, police feared she was the latest victim in a string of similar crimes. A pair of bloody gloves, unique tire tracks and ordinary pine needles provided investigators with some extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cop Out
programme.desc: When a college student is found dead, evidence suggests that he knew his killer. With just three hairs and some microscopic cells, police unravel a web of lies and find the motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Summer Obsession
programme.desc: In an affluent suburb of Philadelphia, police were called to the scene of what appeared to be an accidental drowning. The investigation gradually focused on one suspect who had more than a million reasons to want the victim dead.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Elemental Clue
programme.desc: When two women from the same town were murdered in the same way, police feared a serial killer was on the loose. At first they thought the victims had nothing in common until they found tiny clues linking them to the same man.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Moss, Not Grass
programme.desc: A young woman was found dead on a golf course in the Bahamas. The grass on that course was so distinctive, it had evidentiary value. The evidence led police to two suspects, each of whom blamed the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Material Witness
programme.desc: A teenager went missing after an evening of horseback riding. Her body was found a month later, three miles from her home. But the killer unknowingly left trace evidence behind.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Garden of Evil
programme.desc: When a popular disc jockey was found murdered in a community garden, police swung into action. A sniffer dog and a blood spatter expert led police to the killer, who had been much closer than they realized.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sunday School Ambush
programme.desc: When a man is gunned down in his own garage, investigators use science to unravel a twisted tale of lust, greed and deception.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Penchant for Poison
programme.desc: Three seemingly unrelated deaths prove to be serial murders. The killer had been careful; he used poison which had no taste or odor. Fortunately for investigators, it also had a unique chemical signature.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bump in the Night
programme.desc: When a victim is brutally murdered in his own bed, investigators find a shoe impression in the mud outside — physical evidence they hope will lead to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sole Searching
programme.desc: Armed with little else, police hoped that shoe impressions found at a Lansing, Michigan crime scene would put their investigation of Audrey Nichols' murder back on track.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Murder on the Menu
programme.desc: When the head chef of a historic Philadelphia restaurant was found dead, investigators interviewed the usual suspects: family, friends and coworkers. As they sifted through the evidence, police uncovered a chilling tale of debt and deceit.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hot on the Trail
programme.desc: When Washington, DC is plagued by a series of arson fires — each started with the same type of incendiary device — it's up to forensic scientists to find the clues that lay in the ashes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: High 'n Dry
programme.desc: When Genell Plude is found dead in her bathroom, the scene points to suicide. But a coroner's inquest and a unique application of forensic science give investigators a different explanation for her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: To the Viktor
programme.desc: Faced with three homicides that appear to be professional executions, investigators on both sides of the Atlantic must find a common thread between the victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wired for Disaster
programme.desc: Faced with three homicides that appear to be professional executions, investigators on both sides of the Atlantic must find a common thread between the victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wood-be Killer
programme.desc: A killer tries to incinerate everything that could link him to his crime. But in doing so, he inadvertently creates new forensic evidence. Detectives employ a technique never before used in a criminal investigation to bring it to light.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Naughty or Nyce
programme.desc: A woman appears to have lost control of her SUV and plunged down an embankment into a shallow creek. But investigators suspect foul play when they find snowy footprints leading away from the crime scene.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Going for Broke
programme.desc: When a successful stockbroker doesn't return home after a late shift, his wife reports him missing.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Crime Spree
programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Master Plan
programme.desc: Willow Springs, Illinois, seemed like any other quiet Midwestern community. But it was really one of the most corrupt places in the nation. This tiny village, nestled just outside of Chicago, was in the hip pocket of organized crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Firefight
programme.desc: In Miami, a gang of robbers targeted banks and armored cars. They carried assault weapons and weren't afraid to use them. They struck during the day, and sometimes twice a day. For awhile, they seemed unstoppable.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Abroad
programme.desc: Beginning in 1990, Europe found itself in the clutches of a serial killer. He became an international outlaw, hopping from country to country to evade capture and to kill again.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Moving Target
programme.desc: When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cop Killer
programme.desc: In 1995, our nation's capital was also our nation's murder capital. Even the police weren't safe. While Washington, DC, law enforcement targeted criminals, the criminals targeted law enforcement, even gunning down officers on patrol.

programme.title: The FBI Files: .22 Caliber Killer
programme.desc: In Buffalo, New York, a sniper targeted African-American men. He held a city hostage, and threatened to ignite a racial powder keg. And it looked like others might be following his bloody example.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Grave Secrets
programme.desc: Killers often attempt to deflect attention away from their crimes by hiding the remains of their victims. Bodies may lay hidden for years before they are discovered.

programme.title: The New Detectives: At Close Range
programme.desc: When a victim is gunned down at point-blank range, police often assume that a friend or acquaintance is to blame.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Encounter
programme.desc: In most homicides, police rely on motive to pursue a murderer. But when the killer is a stranger the crime may go unsolved for years. It takes a full arsenal of forensic techniques to trace a lethal encounter.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Crimes Of Passion
programme.desc: When killers are driven by jealousy and desire, their desperation is evident in both the crime and their efforts to avoid detection. But forensic science can reveal even the slightest mistake to solve crimes of passion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Absent Witness
programme.desc: When killers hide or destroy the remains of their victims, it becomes the mission of forensic scientists to reconstruct the scenes and prove murder for an absent witness.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Marked For Death
programme.desc: Sometimes killers are careful to leave no fingerprints behind. But methods of the murder itself can leave a lasting impression on police, especially when the tools (or weapons) of a killer's trade leave an innocent victim marked for death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Abduction
programme.desc: Anytime, anywhere, people disappear, kidnapped from their daily routines. Predators always leave clues behind, but chasing them takes time, hampering investigators' attempts to solve these fatal abductions.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Medical Examiners's Casebook
programme.desc: Some killers choose to hide their victims. And investigators must then rely on forensic examiners to uncover proof of murder. These are just two extraordinary crimes that have made their way into the medical examiner's casebook.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Undaunted
programme.desc: Solving crimes may begin with gut intuition, but advanced science provides investigators with irrefutable proof. When criminals go to great lengths to mask their crimes, investigators must step up the challenge and remain forever undaunted.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Forsaken Trust
programme.desc: When victims of murder know their killers, they are often caught off guard. But even the best-laid plans leave traces of the forsaken trust.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner Investigator
programme.desc: CI: Coroner Investigator will reveal the most in-depth look to date into the science of death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Hidden Obsessions
programme.desc: In San Diego, California, a killer has left behind pieces of evidence. Detectives must sort through these small clues to prove murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blind Trust
programme.desc: A woman's body is found and investigators have little time and few clues to lead them to a killer who could strike again. Perpetrators try to conceal their crimes, yet savvy investigators can take the most obscure data and recreate a murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Shattered Vows
programme.desc: A woman is found dead at the bottom of the basement stairs. As detectives look into the accident, they begin to question the sequence of events.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Impressions
programme.desc: 911 receives a desperate call in Fort Worth, Texas. A man's wife is shot. Forensic investigators search for clues in unlikely places, hoping the victim herself could provide information needed to determine how and why she died.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Misplaced Loyalty
programme.desc: In Northern California, a fire rages in the middle of the night. A woman's charred body is discovered in the smoldering aftermath.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Killing Time
programme.desc: A killer may strike in the middle of the night, and hide clues well. But the police are always there, ready and working, and they will never give up when they're on the trail of criminals who decide it's Killing Time.

programme.title: Fishful Thinking: Slow Death Walleye and Lunkerhunt Goby
programme.desc: An informative episode... first Walleye fishing in the north country. Attention to detail always pay off. Then drop shot rigs for Bass on Lake Erie.
programme.sub-title: Slow Death Walleye and Lunkerhunt Goby

programme.desc: Fishing the St.John area in N.B. for Sturgeon. There are plenty of fish to enjoy but a few tricks, attention to detail and proper boat position can make it even more enjoyable.

programme.title: Fishful Thinking: Big Fish of the Year
programme.desc: A highlight of some of the largest fish caught this year. This is for the viewers who love to see the monsters!!

programme.title: Gone Fishin
programme.desc: Exploring the rugged Paringa River mouth and jet boating the Hall in remote South Westland.

programme.title: Gone Fishin
programme.desc: A relaxing morning of whitebaiting with Sid—classic Kiwi tradition meets underwater spectacle.

programme.title: Gone Fishin
programme.desc: Fishing soft baits and exploring scenic fishing spots around the Cavalli Islands.

programme.title: Gone Fishin
programme.desc: A soft bait masterclass in the Bay of Islands, diving for scallops and a young fisher’s first spear catch.

programme.title: IFISH: Australian Salmon - Port Lincoln, SA
programme.desc: Local knowledge is always best, so when young Archie from Port Lincoln told me we were gonna smash some BIG Australian Salmon off the beach - I knew I was in for one hell of a day!

programme.title: IFISH: Spanish Mackerel - Namotu Island, Fiji
programme.desc: The apple doesn't fall far from the tree. Down rigging big live baits, deep dropping for monsters of the deep and popping for those massive surface strikes - what more could Jet and I ask for!

programme.title: IFISH: Black Bream - Bemm River, VIC
programme.desc: Traditionally bream fishing is a game of bait and wait... well not if Franks around! Local East Gippsland guru, Frank Milito, gives PW a lesson in using vibes for BIG Bemm River bream, that you really must see!

programme.title: IFISH: Sailfish - Darwin, NT
programme.desc: When Paul hears the word "Darwin", two things come to mind - Barra and Crocs! So when PW got invited to fish for sailfish, in 20m of water, he couldn't say no! Get out your note pad and pen, because you're about to learn how you can do it all yourself!

programme.title: IFISH: Barramundi, Horizontal Falls, WA
programme.desc: There is only one thing better than waking up in the remote pristine wilderness of the Kimberley - and that's fishing it! Join the Worsteling tribe as they navigate their way through dense mangrove systems in search of the mighty BARRAMUNDI!

programme.title: IFISH: Yellowtail Kingfish, Jervis Bay, NSW
programme.desc: "Catch the fresh bait, get the BIG fish!" Join the team for a step by step lesson in down rigging fresh baits for big angry Kings!

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 1
programme.desc: Robson Green, the actor and host of Extreme Fishing TV series is our guest. He has never fished for Icelandic salmon. We travel to the remote pools of Kjarrá by helicopter and fish pools that are untouched the whole summer.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 2
programme.desc: Charles and Alex Jardine travel to the highlands of Iceland looking for monster arctic char. Charles Jardine is a respected artist who specializes in painting fish and fisherman. The river they fish is a gin clear river, home to some huge trout.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 3

programme.desc: Gruppen tager til Vegas for at se Brody optræde som dj, og Justin føler sig fanget mellem Audrina og Stephanie. Der udbryder naturbrande i Malibu og Kaitlyn frygter for Brodys liv, da han bliver i evakueringszonen.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I Don't Think We Can Be Friends
programme.desc: Brody og Kaitlynn skal forholde sig til naturbranden i Malibu. Audrina træffer en svær beslutning om Justin. Mischa skal til audition til en stor filmrolle og Heidi vil genoplive sin popsangerinde-karriere.
programme.sub-title: I Don't Think We Can Be Friends

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: You're Enemy #1
programme.desc: Rygterne flyver efter en skadaløs hændelse, der involverer Brody og Stephanie. Audrina får et chok, da Justin tager en flot date med til middagen.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Are We Exclusive?
programme.desc: Kaitlynn & Brodys 'A-liste-galla skaber splid i gruppen, da hun ekskluderer visse medlemmer. Audrina overrasker alle ved at genantænde et forhold til en gammel flamme. Spencer chokerer Heidi med en overdådig overraskelse.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: This Hangover Better Be Expensive
programme.desc: Brody og Kaitlynn har stadig problemer i forholdet, da de besøger en fertilitetslæge. Heidi og Spencer forbereder sig på at forny deres løfter med konkurrerende polterabends. Brandon har svært ved at definere sit nye forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Brody Gets Away with So Much
programme.desc: Brody og Kaitlynns ægteskab er i uføre da rygterne svirrer om deres kærlighedsliv. Efter at have lovet eksklusivitet begynder Brandon at tvivle på sit forhold. Audrina lægger sin skilsmisse bag sig og indleder en ny forretningssatsning.
programme.sub-title: Brody Gets Away with So Much

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Of Course We're Married
programme.desc: Spencer konfronterer Brody med hans ægteskabsstatus og sandheden afsløres. Brandon træffer en endelig beslutning om sit forhold til Ashley. Whitney deler en følelsesladet nyhed med Kaitlynn.

programme.title: The Hills: New City, New Drama
programme.desc: Lauren Conrad jonglerer sin designeruddannelse, et krævende praktikantophold og en uforudsigelig bofælle, der saboterer hendes jobevent, så hun lærer hurtigt, at alt er større i L.A., inklusive hendes problemer.

programme.title: The Hills: A Change of Plans
programme.desc: Da Heidi får et interview til et 'drømmejob', der får hende til at overveje at droppe skolen, indser Lauren, at hun og Heidi er på vej i forskellige retninger.

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Call
programme.desc: Teen Vogue sender Lauren væk på et ærinde til New York, og da hun vender tilbage til L.A. venter der en stor overraskelse fra hendes fortid. Heidi indser, at arbejdet som festarrangør ikke er en stor fest.

programme.title: The Hills: Lauren and Jason: Part 2
programme.desc: Da Jason, Laurens eks fra Laguna Beach, dukker op i hendes liv igen, indser Lauren, at hun måske ikke er kommet sig over ham. I sit nye job spørger Heidi om prisen er for høj.

programme.title: The Hills: Jason's Birthday
programme.desc: Lauren skynder sig hjem fra et Teen Vogue-event for at være sammen med Jason på hans fødselsdag, men aftenen går ikke som forventet. Audrina beder om Heidis råd til hendes seneste date med model/skuespiller Danny.

programme.title: The Hills: Boyfriends and Work Don't Mix
programme.desc: Jason bliver en stor distraktion i Laurens professionelle og akademiske liv. Heidi får endelig sin store chance for at arbejde på natklubberne, men den kunne ikke være kommet på et værre tidspunkt.

programme.title: The Hills: Somebody Always Has to Cry
programme.desc: Det er slængets første ferie i L.A., men ikke alle får, hvad de har ønsket sig. Lauren får svært ved at få et nytårskys, da hun får et uventet opkald fra en gammel flamme.

programme.title: The Hills: You Can't Just Be With Me?
programme.desc: Jason vil gøre Laurens 20 års fødselsdag speciel, men da hun lyver om at arbejde med mandlige modeller til en opgave for Teen Vogue, bliver deres forhold sat på prøve.
programme.sub-title: You Can't Just Be With Me?

programme.title: The Hills: Love is Not a Maybe Thing
programme.desc: Heidi beslutter omsider, at hun har haft nok drama med Jordan. Lauren og Jason tænker på at tage tingene videre til det næste niveau.
programme.sub-title: Love is Not a Maybe Thing

programme.title: The Hills: Timing is Everything
programme.desc: Da Laurens hårde arbejde til modeugen i L.A. fører til en alle tiders karrieremulighed, er hun splittet mellem sit job og sin fyr.

programme.title: The Hills: Out With The Old
programme.desc: Efter en svær sommer med sin fyr Jason, beslutter Lauren at slå op og venter tilbage til Teen Vogue for at møde sin utilfredse chef. Heidi får problemer med en fyr, som både hun og Audrina dater.

programme.title: The Hills: When You Least Expect It
programme.desc: Lauren tager på sin første date efter Jason og bliver sat på prøve, da hun bliver bedt om at arbejde til en modeopvisning. Heidi har en livsforandrende hemmelighed, som hun må fortælle sin fyr.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Body SOS: Shelbie og Liv & Vanessa

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Body SOS: Mahan og Lydia

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Body SOS: Sheena og Georgia

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: I'm Sorry, I'm a Prick
programme.desc: Fem ekser er i villaen og alle er anspændte efter ankomsten af Gaz fra Geordie Shore. Gary bager på Anita og de falder for hinanden. Men hendes eks dukker op af havet, og han knuste hendes hjerte. Imens har Adam en forfærdelig tid.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Star Gazing
programme.desc: Joes ankomst chokerer alle og Anita bliver helt ødelagt. Kayleigh skaber sig og fortæller Joe, at Anita har fjollet rundt med to af fyrene. Den næste eks er et velkendt ansigt som kan ødelægge det for Gaz og Anita. Velkommen Charlotte!

programme.title: Are You The One?: Karma's a Bitch

programme.title: Are You The One?: Double Shot
programme.desc: Situationen er spændt mellem John og Simone. Kayla bliver interesseret i Wes igen, men hun holder stasig fast i Ryan. Humøret stiger, da de kan sende to par i sandhedsboksen efter udfordringen.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Turn The Paige
programme.desc: Alle præver at regne ud, hvem der er det perfekte par. Kayla bliver afsløret, da hun spiller Ryan ud mod Wes, og Simone prøver at splitte Chris T og Shanley. Et besøg i sandhedsboksen vender op og ned på alt i huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: It's So Hard...To Say Goodbye
programme.desc: Huset er rystet, da Paige og Chris T bliver bekræftet som det perfekte par og sendes til Bryllupssuiten. Shanley er totalt knust efter at være blevet skilt fra Chris T, og Kayla flipper ud, da Ryan vil trøste Jessica.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Getting Dumped On
programme.desc: Kayla og Ryan skændes, men huset vender sig mod Kayla, da hun afslører følsomme oplysninger, der truer Ambers forhold til Ethan. En slibrig udfordring tester nogle af parrenes evne til at holde sammen.

programme.title: Are You The One?: White Party

programme.title: Are You The One?: Rub Down With A Happy Ending
programme.desc: Huset forsøger at regne ud, hvordan de finder deres perfekte match og vinder en million dollars. Jacy ser sine følelser for Scali og John i øjnene, da huset forsøger at løse den sidste kærlighedstrekant.
programme.sub-title: Rub Down With A Happy Ending

programme.title: Are You The One?: Are You The One? Special Delivery

programme.sub-title: Are You The One? Special Delivery

programme.title: Are You The One?: The Truth Will Cost You
programme.desc: Teamet bliver spændt, da både Layton og Shelby havner i kærlighedstrekanter. Fyrene graver ting op om pigerne i en konkurrence, som kan sende den ellevte pige i sandhedsbåsen.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Virgin Tears

programme.title: Are You The One?: Loose Lips Sink Relationships
programme.desc: En fuld kikser kan splitte det stærkeste par i huset. Anthony bager heftigt på Laytons forelskelse, Jenni. John prøver endelig lykken med Christina. Parceremonien gør huset helt rundt på gulvet.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Strap Those Boots Tight
programme.desc: Huset er chokeret efter sidste parceremoni. Jenni mener, at Layton er hendes rette fyr, men frygter at en knust Jessica bliver vred. For et par truer sandhedsbåsen med at bringe mere hjertesorg.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Parental Guidance
programme.desc: Pigerne får overraskende informationer, når deres forældre kommer for at udspørge fyrene. Når forældrene rejser, eksploderer spændingerne mellem Layton og Anthony. Huset finder ud af, at historien kan gentage sig.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Hot Salsa
programme.desc: Efter en mislykket parceremoni er huset klar til en ny start. John mener endelig at have fundet den rette i Jenni, men de andre i huset er ikke så sikre. Ashley befinder sig i et potentielt eksplosivt trekantsdrama.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Dumped
programme.desc: Kampen mellem Dario og Layton over Ashley strammer til. Ellie vender sin opmærksomhed mod Nathan, som er overbevist om, at Christina er hans perfekte partner. For Christina bliver presset med at være pige nummer 11 for meget.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Old Flames
programme.desc: Selvom de ikke er et par, eksploderer Nathan, når Christina går tilbage til Brandon. Med to parceremonier tilbage, kunne Ashleys ubeslutsomhed mellem Layton og Dario afholde huset fra at vinde det hele.

programme.title: Awkward: Guilt Trippin'
programme.desc: Jenna's første date til Homecoming-festen vækker skyldige minder om den pige, hun plejede at være og om de piger, der ikke har en date.

programme.title: Awkward: Rubbed Raw and Reeling
programme.desc: En udfordring fra Mr. Hart tvinger Jenna til at blotte sig selv se nogle svære afsløringer om sig selv i øjnene.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Check
programme.desc: Efter at have taget en kop kaffe med Collin en sen aften kan Jenna ikke holde op med at tænke på ham og på, hvad det vil sige både at være småforelsket og at have en kæreste.

programme.title: Awkward: Redefining Jenna
programme.desc: Gnidningerne vokser mellem Jenna og Matty, da Collin inviterer hende til en smart fotografi-udstilling hjemme hos ham.

programme.title: Awkward: Surprise!
programme.desc: Efter at have været sammen med Collin beslutter Jenna sig for at holde op med at være utro før Matty finder ud af det.

programme.title: Awkward: And Then What Happened
programme.desc: Hvad skete der til surprisefesten - og er det virkelig helt slut mellem Jenna og Matty? Det ved kun de to, men deres venner forsøger at finde ud af sandheden.

programme.title: Awkward: Taking Sides
programme.desc: Jenna holder grillfest så hendes venner kan vænne sig til tanken om hendes og Collins spirende forhold. Men da deres støtte udebliver, tager hun drastiske midler i brug.

programme.title: Awkward: The Bad Seed
programme.desc: Efter at være blevet uvenner med Tamara og Ming, synes Jenna ikke at det spiller nogen rolle hvad hun gør længere - og det kaster hende ud i en vanskelig situation.

programme.title: Awkward: A Very Special Episode of Awkward
programme.desc: Val beder Mr Harts klasse om at skrive og fremføre et skuespil, og moralen i historien virker bekendt.
programme.sub-title: A Very Special Episode of Awkward

programme.title: Awkward: Less Than Hero
programme.desc: Efterdønningerne etter Jennas skænderi med vennerne får hende til at gå i byen. Men det som skulle blive en afslappende aften bliver en aften, hun skal reddes fra.

programme.title: Awkward: The Campaign Fail
programme.desc: Det er på tide for Jenna at komme på ret spor igen, men hun har forårsaget mere skade for sine nærmeste en hun kan rette op med med lidt PR. Vil de tilgive hende, eller må hun tage drastiske midler brug?

programme.title: Awkward: Old Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna og pigerne er gode venner igen og Jenna mener, at hun er klar til at genoptage forholdet til Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Karmic Relief
programme.desc: Jenna håber, at hvis hun retter op på sine fejl ved at hjælpe Val med at få sit job tilbage, vil universet belønne hende med at sørge for, at hun og Matty finder sammen igen.

programme.title: Awkward: Who I Want To Be
programme.desc: Jenna bliver udfordret til at sætte spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem hun vil være i den episke sæsonfinale.

programme.title: Awkward: Most Awkward Moments
programme.desc: Pinlige øjeblikke venter, når vi tager et kig på de bedste klip fra 'Awkward', hvor skuespillerne selv kommenterer de sjoveste replikker, de saftigste forhold og meget mere fra deres yndlingsafsnit af 'Awkward'.

programme.title: Awkward: Prank Amateurs
programme.desc: En række pranks skaber kaos og Jennas forsæt om at holde op med at tænke på Matty bliver sat på prøve, da hun overhører en chokerende hemmelighed.

programme.title: Awkward: Short Circuit Party
programme.desc: Jenna er skyld i en ulykke på skolen, som får overraskende følger. Samtidig må Matty håndtere konsekvenserne af konfrontationen med Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna In Wonderland
programme.desc: Mens Jenna nyder lidt popularitet, har Matty det svært med at blive holdt uden for. Samtidig bager Jake på den nye pige, og Ally holder en sexlege-fest.

programme.title: Awkward: Now You See Me, Now I Don't
programme.desc: Årbøgerne er kommet ud. Jenna bliver helt nede over stikordet under hendes billede, men hvad vil Matty skrive i hendes årbog?
programme.sub-title: Now You See Me, Now I Don't

programme.title: Awkward: The Dis-Engagement Dinner
programme.desc: Jenna tvinges til at holde en fest for Tamara for at fejre hendes falske forlovelse. Samtidig får Jenna en hemmelighed at vide om Matty, der sender hende ud på en jagt efter sandheden.

programme.title: Awkward: Don't Dream It's Over
programme.desc: Da Tamara siger, at Jenna ødelægger forhold, konfronterer Jenna sine ekskærester med overraskende resultater.

programme.title: Awkward: The Big Reveal
programme.desc: Jenna vil afsløre sandheden for Matty, men vil hendes nærmeste stoppe hende?

programme.title: Awkward: An Indecent Promposal
programme.desc: Eleverne inviterer hinanden til bal, og Jenna får nogle overraskende nyheder.

programme.title: Awkward: Say No To The Dress
programme.desc: Jenna har bestemt sig for at få det perfekte bal, men der er mange forhindringer i vejen.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Does Not Bite
programme.desc: Skoleballet byder på mange overraskelser.

programme.title: Awkward: The Graduates
programme.desc: Eksamensfesten kan blive ødelagt, da Sadie fået et forbud mod at gå hente sit bevis.

programme.title: Awkward: Holding on and Letting Go
programme.desc: Alle prøver at få den sidste aften på skolen til at blive noget særligt.

programme.title: Awkward: I'm the Kind of Girl Who Found Her Voice in College
programme.desc: Jenna er på toppen af verden, da hun kommer hjem fra sit første år på college, men hendes nye selvtillid rystes, da hun opdager, at hun ikke er den eneste, som har forandret sig.
programme.sub-title: I'm the Kind of Girl Who Found Her Voice in College

programme.title: Awkward: WTF Happened Last Year?
programme.desc: Jenna afslører, hvad der skete med hende og resten af slænget i året der gik - hvad der var grunden til det kølige forhold mellem Matty og Jenna, hvad der startede venskabet mellem Sadie og Tamara og hvordan Jake og Lissa fandt romantikken.

programme.title: Awkward: The Friend Connection
programme.desc: Jenna undgår et nyt forhold for at få kontakt med dem, hun arbejder sammen med. Imens holder Tamara en chik fødselsdagsfest for Sadie - som efterlader mere end en festdeltager i dårligt festhumør.

programme.title: Awkward: Best Friends For Never
programme.desc: I et forsøg på at gøre Idea Bin til et hyggeligere sted for hende selv, skaffer Jenna en praktikplads til Tamara, men opdager hurtigt, det kan være katastrofalt at arbejde med venner.

programme.title: Awkward: Fireworks
programme.desc: Jake giver Jenna og Tamara vagter i country-klubben den 4. juli, men Sullys planer om en efterfest på golfbanen resulterer i et dramatisk fyrværkeri.

programme.title: Awkward: Digging Deep
programme.desc: Efter en sjov 4. juli, fortsætter Jenna og Matty med at fyre op under venskabet ved at holde fest for Jake - i det mindste indtil Jennas nyeste Idea Bin-post truer med at afsløre alt.

programme.title: Awkward: Girls Gone Viral
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at vælge mellem succes hos Idea Bin og sit venskab med Matty. Jake oplever et uventet intimt møde, og Sadie og Sergio afslører pludselig mere end nogensinde før.

programme.title: Awkward: Misadventures in Babysitting
programme.desc: Jenna melder sig som barnepige og modtager uventet hjælp af Matty. Imens får Lissa at vide, hvad der er hemmeligheden ved at være en Palos Hills-mor, og Tamara og Sadie får mere end nok til en rig teenagers strandfest.

programme.title: Awkward: Living in Sin
programme.desc: Jenna tager forholdet med Luke et nyt niveau og Tamaras gæld kommer tilbage og bider hende i halen.

programme.title: Awkward: Home Again, Home Again
programme.desc: Et skænderi med Luke presser Jenna til at tage med til lejrgenforeningen og dermed mod at genoptage kontakten med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Second Chances
programme.desc: Luke hjælper Jenna med at få et vigtigt møde på SCU, Tamara er ærlig over for Patrick om sine pengeproblemer, og Matty får Sadies hjælp til at komme ind i varmen igen hos Lacey.

programme.title: Awkward: Happy Campers, Happier Trails
programme.desc: Jenna må vælge mellem et vigtigt SCU-event og lejrgenforeningen, noget der fører til et endnu større valg: Luke eller Matty. Men hun er ikke alene, for både Jake, Tamara og Lissa må også tage afgørende valg.

programme.title: What If
programme.desc: Da den håbløse romantiker Wallace møder Chantry, har de kemi med det samme. Der er bare ét problem: hun har en kæreste. De beslutter sig for at ses som venner, men det bliver sværere og sværere at holde venskabet og de voksende følelser adskilt.

programme.title: Café Society
programme.desc: New York i 1930’erne. Bobby har brug for luftforandring og er desperat for at komme væk fra sine emsige forældre, sin gangsterbror og familiens juvelerforretning. Bobby beslutter sig for at prøve lykken i Hollywood.

programme.title: A Good Old Fashioned Orgy
programme.desc: 30-årige Eric og en gruppe gamle high school-venner holder hver sommer vilde fester i hans forældres strandhus. Da hans far planlægger at sælge huset, må Eric indse, at det er tid til at blive voksen. Der skal dog lige afholdes én sidste fest.

programme.title: 99 Homes
programme.desc: Ærligt og hårdt arbejde betaler sig ikke! Det lærer Dennis Nash (Andrew Garfield), på den hårde måde, da han må forlade sit barndomshjem og bliver sat på gaden af den karismatiske og bevæbnede ejendomsspekulant, Rick Carver (Michael Shannon).

programme.title: All Nighter
programme.desc: En hård forretningsmand (J.K. Simmons) bliver bekymret, da han ikke kan få fat i sin datter (Analeigh Tipton), og beder hendes dovne ekskæreste (Emile Hirsch) om at hjælpe ham med at lede efter hende.

programme.title: Couples Vacation
programme.desc: Mens hans ægteskab og karriere hænger i en tynd tråd, tager den arbejdsløse forfatter Jack Spencer sammen med sin kone Amanda til et afsides 'glamping'-sted for at finde gnisten igen. Men en overraskende dobbeltbooking...

programme.title: Brad's Status
programme.desc: Brad har en udmærket karriere og lever et komfortabelt liv sammen med sin hustru og søn, men hans gamle venners liv virker mere glamourøst og rigt. Da han genoptager kontakten med dem, kommer han dog til at tvivle på, hvem der lever det gode liv.

programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: Efter næsten at have mistet livet i “Daredevil” ersuperheltinden ELEKTRA tilbage i en verden af drab ogbedrag – stærkere, smukkere og smidigere end før, men...

programme.title: The Fountain
programme.desc: Hugh Jackman og den Oscar® vindende Rachel Weiszspinder instruktøren Darren Aronofsky en tidløs fabel om en mands søgen efter Livets Træ.

programme.title: The Catcher Was A Spy
programme.desc: En usædvanlig spion udfører en hemmelig mission under 2. verdenskrig, hvor virkelighed og bedrag konfronteres i en intens kamp mod fjenden.

programme.title: Biker Boyz
programme.desc: Smoke, "Kongen af Cali," er den ubesejrede racermester. Hans dominans og titlen udfordres af Kid, et ungt racergeni, i denne historie om moderne vovehalse og det ultimative løb for, at den hurtigste overlever.

programme.title: Slow West
programme.desc: En ung skotte rejser gennem det vilde vesten for at finde sin tabte kærlighed. Han allierer sig med en mystisk fremmed på en farefuld færd.

programme.title: Only God Forgives
programme.desc: Julian, en narkosmugler i Bangkoks kriminelle underverden, ser sit liv blive endnu mere indviklet, da hans mor trygler ham om at finde og dræbe den ansvarlige for hans brors nylige død.

programme.title: Centurion
programme.desc: Quintus er romersk centurion. Sammen med sine mænd er han fanget i fjendeland, omringet af stammefolket picterne. På hjemmebane er picterne en svær modstander, og Quintus og hans mænd må kæmpe vel vidende, at hvert øjeblik kan blive deres sidste.

programme.title: Slow West
programme.desc: En ung skotte rejser gennem det vilde vesten for at finde sin tabte kærlighed. Han allierer sig med en mystisk fremmed på en farefuld færd.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.
programme.sub-title: The True Story of Mississippi Burning

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When law enforcement officers become targets, no one is safe. So when a crystal meth dealer on the run from the law began shooting cops, it took more than police to stop him.

programme.title: Angreb! Er det bedste forsvar
programme.desc: To snobbede millionærer fra Rio de Janeiro bliver udsat for pengeafpresning. Heldigvis møder de Elliott Vance (Terence Hill) og Greg Wonder (Bud Spencer), som ligner dem på en prik, og de hyrer dem for en tid som stand-ins.

programme.title: A Christmas Feast
programme.desc: Det er jul, og familien Oliverio gør sig klar til De Syv Fiskes Middag, en italiensk madtradition. Tony, en ung mand med store drømme og et endnu større hjerte, er med i forberedelserne og spekulerer på, om han mon vil finde kærligheden denne jul

programme.title: No Stranger Than Love
programme.desc: Hvad kan være mærkeligere end det hul, der opstår i Lucy Sherringtons stuegulv? Svaret viser sig at være kærlighed.

programme.title: Også engle spiser bønner
programme.desc: Charlie er fribryder i forbudstidens New York, og han nægter at være med til at fikse en kamp, og gangsterbossen Angelo har satset penge på modstanderen. Han bliver nødt til at flygte, og under flugten støder han på Sonny, der også er på flugt.

programme.title: How to Be
programme.desc: En skæv ungdomskomedie om Art (Robert Pattinson), som bliver forladt af kæresten og flytter tilbage til far og mor, hvorefter han får en 25-års krise.

programme.title: Tully
programme.desc: 'Tully' er skrevet og instrueret af skaberne af den højtelskede Oscar-vinder 'Juno'. Skrevet af Diablo Cody (Young Adult) og instrueret af Jason Reitman (Thank You for Smoking, Up in the Air og Young Adult).

programme.title: Who Gets The Dog
programme.desc: Da Olive og Clay mødte hinanden, var det kærlighed ved første blik. De blev gift, købte hus sammen og adopterede en hvalp – Wesley. Nu er det seks år senere, og de har besluttet at gå fra hinanden, men de vil begge beholde deres elskede Wesley.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Nogen er gået for vidt med din kærlighed til efterfølgere! Favoritfigurerne fra SCARY MOVIE er tilbage i en film, der skræmmer til mere uærbødig morskab end originalen med sin version af kliche-spøgelsesfilm.

programme.title: Youth In Revolt
programme.desc: På en ferie møder den kiksede teenager Nick Twisp drømmepigen Sheeni. Nick, der ikke tidligere har haft held med piger, vil gøre alt for at vinde hendes hjerte og opfinder et alter-ego, den flamboyante og dristige Francois Dillinger.

programme.title: P.S.
programme.desc: En nyligt skilt kvinde får muligheden for at genopleve sin fortid, da hun møder en ung mand, der tilsyneladende er hendes gymnasie kæreste, der døde mange år tidligere.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Louisiana, a brutal killer turned a rural area into his personal hunting ground. He preyed on the defenseless, the weak and the elderly.

programme.title: Fraud Squad: Episode 211 - Romance Fraud
programme.desc: Romance and relationship frauds can be particularly devastating due to the amount of personal involvement between the criminal and victim.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Partners In Crime
programme.desc: They say that a burden shared is a burden halved, but when partners team up to commit murder, the weight of their guilt remains just as heavy. Investigators must rely on forensic science to capture partners in crime.

programme.title: Fraud Squad: Episode 212 - ID Theft (Glass/Staab)

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Korra Alone
programme.desc: Korra's three-year journey of healing takes her to unexpected places.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: The Coronation
programme.desc: Prince Wu's big day is ruined by Kuvira; Korra thinks she may have found the key to a full recovery.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: The Calling
programme.desc: Tenzin tasks Jinora, Ikki, and Meelo with a mission of the utmost importance - to find Korra.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Enemy at the Gates
programme.desc: Kuvira threatens Zaofu; Bolin is caught in the middle of the bad blood between Su Beifong and Kuvira.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Battle of Zaofu
programme.desc: Korra returns to her role as the Avatar, but is she really ready for action? Bolin and Varrick break from Kuvira's army.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Reunion
programme.desc: Korra returns to Republic City and Team Avatar faces their first mission together in three years when Prince Wu goes missing; Bolin and Varrick are on the lam.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Remembrances
programme.desc: A look back at Team Avatar's journey; Varrick tells the story of the greatest move ever made.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Beyond the Wilds
programme.desc: The spirit vines in Republic City start abducting people and it's up to Korra to figure out why.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Operation Beifong
programme.desc: Bolin helps Opal and Lin save the Beifongs from Kuvira; Korra visits the Spirit World looking for help.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Kuvira's Gambit
programme.desc: Korra and Team Avatar try to stop Kuvira from moving against Republic City; Kuvira unveils a deadly new weapon.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Day of the Colossus
programme.desc: Team Avatar clashes with Kuvira on the streets of Republic City; Pema and Prince Wu help evacuate innocent citizens.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: The Last Stand
programme.desc: The fate of the Earth Kingdom and the Avatar's life is at stake, when Korra comes face to face with Kuvira.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Boy in the Iceberg
programme.desc: When a young waterbender, named Katara, and her brother, Sokka, discover a giant iceberg while fishing for food around their homestead at the South Pole, they discover that there is a boy, named Aang, inside.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Avatar Returns
programme.desc: After Aang accidentally sets off a Fire Nation trap, he is banished from the South Pole. Soon after Prince Zuko attacks the Southern Water Tribe seeking to capture the Avatar. Aang returns and surrenders to save the Water Tribe.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Southern Air Temple
programme.desc: Aang is eager to take Sokka and Katara to the Air Temple where he was raised. But upon arrival, it becomes apparent that the temple is not at all how Aang remembers it.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Warriors of Kyoshi
programme.desc: As one of Aang's little detours, the group heads toward the island of Kyoshi. But soon they learn that the townspeople don't trust foreigners at all; however, when Aang proves to them that he is the Avatar they are treated as guests of honor.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The King of Omashu
programme.desc: Aang takes Katara and Sokka back to a favorite place he used to go to when he was younger, the Earth Kingdom City of Omashu. But when they break the law they are taken to the King to get their punishment.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Imprisoned
programme.desc: The kids come to an Earth Nation town which is occupied by the Fire Nation. But will Katara's attempts to inspire the oppressed people help them or hurt them?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Winter Solstice Part 1: The Spirit World
programme.desc: Aang, Katara, and Sokka arrive at a town being terrorized by a mysterious force from the spirit world. Aang doesn't know how to help these people, and realizes he has much to learn about being the Avatar.
programme.sub-title: Winter Solstice Part 1: The Spirit World

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Winter Solstice Part 2: Avatar Roku
programme.desc: During the winter solstice, Aang must reach a Fire Nation temple while dodging Prince Zuko, Commander Zhao, and the Fire Sages who guard it.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Waterbending Scroll
programme.desc: After Katara attempts to teach Aang waterbending, she is desperate to improve her abilities.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Jet
programme.desc: While traveling towards the North Pole, the group almost gets captured by the Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Great Divide
programme.desc: When Aang and friends come to the rim of a giant canyon, they are asked to help guide two groups of refugees across.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Storm
programme.desc: A powerful storm brings up painful memories of the past - and puts everyone in jeopardy in the present.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Blue Spirit
programme.desc: After Sokka and Katara get sick due to being in the storm, Aang seeks out a cure and discovers he needs some frozen frogs in order to get them cured.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Fortuneteller
programme.desc: Aang, Katara, and Sokka discover a village of people who are all reliant on a fortuneteller in their everyday lives - but they are so reliant that they are blind to the immanent danger they are all in.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Bato of the Water Tribe
programme.desc: Aang feels insecure when Katara and Sokka come across something that reminds them of home. Because Aang thinks his friends might leave him, he hides an important message which only leads to trouble.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Deserter
programme.desc: Aang attempts to find a Firebending master to teach him while Katara learns that she possesses a special power.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Northern Air Temple
programme.desc: After hearing rumors about surviving Airbenders, the kids journey to the Northern Air temple to see for themselves. What they find there could spell disaster for all enemies of the Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Waterbending Master
programme.desc: The kids reach the Northern Water tribe, and Aang and Katara look for a Waterbending Master as Sokka falls for a princess. Meanwhile, Zhao plans an attack and Zuko must find a way to continue his quest for the Avatar.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Siege of the North Part 1
programme.desc: The Northern Water Tribe braces itself for an attack by Admiral Zhao's Fire Navy fleet. In the heat of battle, Aang struggles to defend the city. He wonders if there isn't a better way to use his Avatar abilities.
programme.sub-title: The Siege of the North Part 1

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Siege of the North Part 2
programme.desc: Zhao's invasion breaks through the outer wall of the Northern Water Tribe's defenses, and he reveals a sinister plan.
programme.sub-title: The Siege of the North Part 2

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Avatar State
programme.desc: Aang and the group meet an Earth Kingdom general who wants to use Aang's powerful "Avatar State" as a weapon to defeat the Fire Nation. But getting into the "Avatar state" on purpose is more difficult than Aang thinks.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Cave of Two Lovers
programme.desc: On their way to Omashu, the kids meet a group of nomads who show them a short cut through the 'cave of two lovers'.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Return to Omashu
programme.desc: The kids return to Omashu so that Aang can learn Earthbending from King Bumi. But when they get there, they are shocked to find the city is now in Fire Nation hands. Despite the danger, Aang enters Omashu in search of King Bumi.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly møder Victorious
programme.desc: Carly mistænker, at hendes nye fyr, Steven, er utro med Tori Vega, så slænget planlægger en tur til Los Angeles for at afsløre ham til en fest, som Andre holder i Kenan Thompsons hus.

programme.title: iCarly: Datehjælpen
programme.desc: Carly træder til for at løse et skænderi mellem Sam og Freddie. Snart kommer Freddie og Sam til Carly for at få hjælp med hvert eneste skænderi. Nu hvor hun er involveret, hvordan kan Carly så trække sig?

programme.title: iCarly: Nærmest uudholdeligt
programme.desc: Mrs. Benson opdager Sam og Freddies forhold efter Gibby, som Sam nu håner, og planlægger at skille dem ad. Vil Carly kæmpe for Sam og Freddie, eller hjælpe Gibby med at skille dem ad?

programme.title: iCarly: Fuld af kærlighed
programme.desc: Carly siger, at Sam og Freddie skal prøve hinandens yndlingshobbier. Imens møder Spencer en gammel barnepige og inviterer hende ud på middag. Men bliver de sammen, efter de falder tilbage i deres gamle roller?

programme.title: iCarly: iQ
programme.desc: Carly vil imponere en ny fyr ved at prøve at se smartere ud, end hun er. Og slænget prøver at finde et nyt sted at bo til T-Bo, efter han bliver smidt ud af Groovy Smoothie.

programme.title: iCarly: Førstedamen
programme.desc: Et føderalt bureau begynder at undersøge iCarly-slænget, efter de hacker ind i et sikkert netværk for at holde netfødselsdag for Carlys far. *Gæstestjerne - Michelle Obama.

programme.title: iCarly: Fedtekage-tyv
programme.desc: Slænget, minus Carly, tager Sam med til Canadian Fat Cake-fabrikken, men så kan Sam ikke komme ind i Amerika igen. Imens har Carly problemer i badet, mens hun gør sig klar til en date.

programme.title: iCarly: En øjenåbner
programme.desc: Efter at være blevet affærdiget i et interview om iCarly, prøver Freddie at vise sin kreative side ved at webcaste iCarly i 3D. Spencer hyrer en assistent, som han ikke har råd til at betale.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly-brølere 2
programme.desc: Christopher Cane, skuespilleren, der spiller Rex on Victorious, vender tilbage som vært i et dybdeborende interview med stjernerne fra iCarly og viser deres vildt sjove bloopers/fraklip. *Gæstestjerne: Rex fra Victorious.
